svg.title: MatrixHub architecture
svg.desc: The UI, CLI for Hugging Face login, download, and upload, and Git clone, pull, and push access the server. The server contains a UI, authentication and authorization middleware, handlers, job processors, domain modules, and repository implementations. Domain modules include user, project, role, registry, robot account, model, sync policy, sync job, Git, and cleanup. External storage includes a database, NFS, S3, and a possible future Redis.
